subject.title: fix(hooks): wire message:sending internal hook to user-defined hooks

question: Should file-based internal hooks gain a new pre-delivery observation event, and if so must it observe only the final post-policy payload that will actually be sent?
rationale: Current documentation reserves ordered rewriting and cancellation for typed plugin hooks, while this PR creates a new workspace-code boundary that can expose pre-filter or cancelled content; permanent semantics require an owner decision.

options.title: Post-policy observer
options.body: Add an observation-only event after plugin policy resolves, skip cancelled messages, and document that it cannot rewrite or veto delivery.

options.title: True pre-policy hook
options.body: Expose original content before policy only with explicit security approval, ordering semantics, documentation, and compatibility tests.

options.title: Keep plugin-only policy
options.body: Do not add the internal event and direct pre-send filtering or interception use cases to the typed `message_sending` plugin API.

recommendation.title: Post-policy observer
recommendation.body: Add an observation-only event after plugin policy resolves, skip cancelled messages, and document that it cannot rewrite or veto delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent maintainer-associated work directly defines exactly-once `message_sending` ownership and ordering across outbound paths.
